body:
I have been experimenting using GHB for the past few months now. Overall my experiences with it have been very positive, apart from one moment of nausea and a hero moment when I took too much and passed out, thus freaking out my friends and acquaintances. Just this weekend though I decided to mix it with some MDMA at a club. I'd dosed myself with my normal dose of 4mls of highly concentrated GHB (home baked) at 11.30pm and arrived at the club around midnight. My friends who'd taken a similar amount were all reporting a good high, while I wasn't feeling much at all. At 12.15 I decided to push things along a little with an extra 0.5mls of G. By 12.45am I was starting to get more into the swing so I dropped a single pill of MDMA.
By 1am I was well toasted by the G and was on the dancefloor. But in the half hour I spent there things got very disorienting. The normal levels of dizziness one gets from G were gradually amplified to the point where I could barely tell what was in front of me. Luckily I was with some friends who took me out of there and up to the balcony for some fresh air. Before I knew it I was overwhelmed by nausea and vomited over the balcony railing and onto some oblivious fern trees below. I was dripping with sweat, feeling like a crane had dunked me in a swimming pool and deposited me into a nightclub.
I was dripping with sweat, feeling like a crane had dunked me in a swimming pool and deposited me into a nightclub.
Not pleasant! I sat down, hung my head and waited for the nausea to dissipate.
Over the course of the next half hour my eyesight slowly returned to normal and the nausea and dizziness subsided. For much of it, any kind of body movement would make me feel like vomiting so I just stayed as still as I could. By about 2.15am I felt more or less returned to normal with just the last vestiges of the E hanging around, so I returned to the dancefloor. By 3am the club closed and it was time to head back home.
What I can glean from this experience is that when I'm high on G I have a nausea level that is just sitting underneath my powers of perception, waiting to escape if the conditions are right. As MDMA can have slight but noticable effects on my digestive system, this was all that was necessary to bring me to a state of strong nausea. In short, I would recommend waiting till the G was on its dying stage before dosing with MDMA and vice versa.
